groups.name: NASDAQ SETUP
groups.label: Mixed / Neutral
groups.explanation:
⚠️ Material bearish change. Treasury yields remain the main pressure point, with the 2Y at 4.579% and the 10Y at 4.896%. Semiconductor momentum remains an important equity confirmation: SOXX has risen for 1 consecutive session. QQQ is -4.99% over five sessions and -5.41% versus its 20-day average. Brent is -8.09% at about $95.22, providing some inflation relief.

The Nasdaq Setup is mixed/neutral (-9/100, 60% confidence, deteriorating ↓). The current balance is persistent semiconductor momentum, falling oil on the supportive side versus weaker intraday semiconductor leadership, semiconductor/AI leaders trading below their earnings AVWAPs as the main headwind.

Near-term risk is concentrated in semiconductor leadership is lagging QQQ. Improvement in these conditions would strengthen the setup; further deterioration would reduce conviction.
